question: Ramdin started from his office and walked 15 km in the south direction and reached the bus stop, and then turned to his left and walked 8 km straight on the road. From there, he turned to his left, walked 15 km and reached the Central Library. After this, he turned to his left again and walked 4 km to reach his hostel. How far and in which direction is the hostel with respect to his office?
solution:
Drawing the diagram according to the given information,

 
• 
 
Ramdin started from his office and walked 15 km in the south direction and reached the bus stop.

 
 
• 
 
Then turned to his left and walked 8 km straight on the road.

 
 
• 
 
Thne turned to his left, walked 15 km and reached the Central Library.

 
 
• 
 
After this, he turned to his left again and walked 4 km to reach his hostel. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c5239a3ac9bd4d11b4df27f68c24798e159c98b88c95cfd2de31d37b8fd1ae5.png] 

Hence, the hostel is "**4 km towards East**" with respect to his office.
